rules.statement: Exclude generated code from coverage where coverage is collected (coverlet runsettings `ExcludeByFile`/`ExcludeByAttribute`), not through separate filter lists in ReportGenerator or `codecov.yml` `ignore`.
rules.why: When exclusion happens at collection, every presenter reads the same input from one list. Two filter lists in two syntaxes have to be kept equal, and they drift.
rules.check: Look for diffs that add coverage exclusions to ReportGenerator `-filefilters`/`-classfilters` or to a `codecov.yml` `ignore` section instead of to the coverlet runsettings file.

rules.statement: Do not exclude `[CompilerGenerated]` members from code coverage.
rules.why: The compiler puts that attribute on async state machines, lambdas and iterator classes, so excluding it drops the bodies of hand-written async methods and lambdas from coverage.
rules.check: Look for `CompilerGeneratedAttribute` in a coverlet `ExcludeByAttribute` setting or any other coverage exclusion list.

rules.statement: Keep hand-written shipped code in coverage scope, including host and deployment projects, and do not exclude assemblies just to raise the coverage figure.
rules.why: Host code ships in the deployed artifact, so a low figure there shows a real gap. Excluding it would hide that gap.
rules.check: Look for new coverage exclusions (assembly filters, `[ExcludeFromCodeCoverage]`, file globs) aimed at hand-written production code rather than generated or scaffolded code.

rules.statement: In a project that holds scaffolded EF Core migrations, put hand-written code outside the `Migrations/` folder.
rules.why: Coverage collection excludes files under `Migrations/` as scaffolded code, so hand-written code there would quietly drop out of coverage.
rules.check: Look for new hand-written classes (helpers, extensions, custom operations) added under a `Migrations/` directory that are not `dotnet ef` scaffolded migrations or model snapshots.

rules.statement: Configure Codecov to count a partially covered line as a hit (`parsers.cobertura.partials_as_hits: true`) so its line coverage matches ReportGenerator's.
rules.why: By default Codecov counts partially covered lines as misses while ReportGenerator counts them as covered, so the two reported figures disagree.
rules.check: Look for a `codecov.yml` change that removes or disables `parsers.cobertura.partials_as_hits`, or a new `codecov.yml` that leaves it out.
